acceptance_rule: IAPWS IF97 verification states must reproduce tabulated density to numerical precision.
Ingest independent n-hexane density/EOS verification or experimental rows; do not fit volume translation on this validation set.
Ingest long-chain n-alkane density rows, preferably n-C16 and neighboring cuts, with source uncertainties.
Squalane holdout can reject gross density behavior but cannot validate the real Middle pseudo-component.
Squalane is only a lower-complexity saturated benchmark; Heavy requires heavy-cut/residue density data.
Any volume translation must be fitted on a separate calibration subset/source and evaluated here without retuning.
Reservoir density validation remains blocked until each oil pseudo-component has an admissible independent validation envelope.
